findings.title: Missing idempotency key in webhook call
findings.body: The webhook handler calls `record_payment` without the new `idempotency_key` parameter introduced in this change. This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime because the function now requires three arguments.

summary.problem: The webhook handler does not pass the required idempotency key to the updated `record_payment` function, causing a runtime error.
summary.done_well: The change adds idempotency support to `record_payment` and uses `find_by_key` to avoid duplicate payments.
